utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in for this afternoon — I can swing by after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time do you think you’ll be able to come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools by for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know what we end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep a few basics ready and check back with you closer to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are lining up stuff for it already — seems like a really good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I hope someone’s keeping track of where everything goes. It gets messy fast if the logistics aren’t sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, absolutely — someone should be tagging each item as it comes in. I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s doing a proper sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—could you help me track which homes are done and which ones still need a stop?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can keep a simple list of done homes and the ones still left to visit. Just send me the names as you go, and I’ll track them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, definitely—I'll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Uli wants, I can also invite a few more neighbors to come by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be really kind, Quinn. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll ask around this afternoon and let folks know to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m keeping things organized. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa — just send me the date, time, and what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the date and time, plus a short tools list, in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the basics—leaky faucets, squeaky doors, and small patch-up jobs people’ve been putting off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—so we’re focusing on small home fixes like faucets, doors, and patch jobs. Do you want me to help organize them by house or by type of repair?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—just tell me what times work best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Faye—after school and early evening usually work best for folks. I’ll send you the time windows I’ve heard back on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—send them over and I’ll work around pickup and dinner times. I can help line up the schedule once I see the windows.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are signing up for different jobs, and we’re still looking for a few extra hands this weekend. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help—I’ve only caught scraps. What jobs are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in — just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm you’ll just follow the repair drive details exactly?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll follow the repair drive details exactly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I’m still getting the details together, but I’ll let you know what needs fixing as soon as I’ve sorted it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to drop by the repair drive later and let folks know what’s still needed. If you want, I can pass along any items you’ve got to contribute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare screws and some duct tape I can add. Thanks for passing it along!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll add those to the list and mention them when I stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a lot of support already—sounds like folks are really pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I should probably stop by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’d do that if you can—last I heard they still needed a few hands and maybe some supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’m still ironing out the details too, but I’ll keep everyone posted and repeat the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just let me know what I can do when the plan’s clearer.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard about that—what changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just the date and the drop-off spot — I can send you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, send me the details when you can — I’ll probably forget otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a short list of tools and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—could you help greet folks at the start and hand out the task list? If you’re free, I can put your name down right now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can greet people and hand out the task list. Go ahead and put my name down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive — want me to spread the word to my friends too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules — the more people who know, the better. I’ll keep track of who’s coming and where they heard about it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start passing it along to my friends and mention your name so they know where to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s make a quick list of what needs fixing and who can help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies and list what we’re short on. Just tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll note who has what.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll start the repair list and send it over so you can match supplies to each job. Once we see the gaps, we’ll know exactly what to ask the neighbors for.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s moving along, but I need a quick status check—have we got enough volunteers for the afternoon shift?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and see who’s still available for the afternoon shift.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need fixed for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly I just need the car checked over so it’s safe for school drop-offs and pickups. If you can take a look at the brakes and tires, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can take a quick look at the brakes and tires for you. I’ll see if anything obvious needs fixing before the school runs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s on the repair drive and whether you’ve got the right tools for it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check what’s on the repair drive and see what tools I have. Give me a minute, and I’ll tell you if anything’s missing.
